title: Exterior powers of sheaves of modules and determinant lines
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal E$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For $n\geq0$, let $P_n(U)=\bigwedge^n_{\mathcal O_X(U)}\mathcal E(U)$, the module exterior power [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra]. Its restriction from $U$ to $V\subseteq U$ is the unique semilinear map sending $e_1\wedge\cdots\wedge e_n$ to $e_1|_V\wedge\cdots\wedge e_n|_V$; these maps satisfy the identity and composition laws. Define $\bigwedge^n\mathcal E$ as the sheafification of $P_n$. The wedge of local sections is their sectionwise wedge followed by the canonical map to sheafification. In degree zero this is canonically isomorphic to $\mathcal O_X$. If $\mathcal E$ is finite locally free of constant rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], its determinant line is $\det(\mathcal E)=\bigwedge^r\mathcal E$, with the degree-zero identification giving $\det(0)=\mathcal O_X$.
